triage.note: ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. American Express FY2008 addresses Part III under ONE combined heading covering four item codes at once -- raw bytes at offset 1225493 of evals/heldout/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm: 'ITEMS 10, 11, 12 and 13.' followed by 'DIRECTORS, EXECUTIVE OFFICERS AND CORPORATE GOVERNANCE; EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION; SECURITY OWNERSHIP OF CERTAIN BENEFICIAL OWNERS AND MANAGEMENT AND RELATED STOCKHOLDER MATTERS; CERTAIN RELATIONSHIPS AND RELATED TRANSACTIONS, AND DIRECTOR INDEPENDENCE', immediately followed by the proxy pointer 'We expect to file with the SEC, in March 2009 ... a definitive proxy statement ... The following information to be included in such proxy statement is incorporated herein by reference:'. The pipeline reports all four items `missing` at confidence 0.40 with warning `expected_item_missing` and doc_status `success_with_warning`. That is an HONEST miss, not a silent failure -- low confidence, warning fired, absence admitted -- but it is a miss: the heading is physically present and the body is an explicit external incorporation by reference, so the correct status for each of the four is `incorporated_by_reference` (ADR-004 keyword-evidenced IBR; ADR-011 keeps offsets on the pointer text). WHY IT IS NOT FIXED HERE: every heading path in src/sec10k/segment.py matches ONE item code per heading. Recognizing a heading that enumerates several codes and fanning one span out to all of them is a new capability, forbidden by the T8 freeze without its own ADR (same reasoning as cvx-2015-internal-pointer and ba-2003-asterisk-ibr). WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND ITSELF: this is the only item-recall gap in either eval set that occurs in a real EDGAR filing with content actually present to find -- the other 11 `missing` items in the dev corpus are either genuinely absent from the document (xom-2021 item 6, which FY2021 filings no longer contain at all; malformed-html item 1A, whose body does not survive the corruption) or live in synthetic fixtures whose own committed expectations assert `missing` as the CORRECT answer (heading-unnumbered item 8; items-stripped-escalation items 5/6/7/7A/8/9/9A/9B). It is therefore the whole real-filing addressable surface that ADR-020 weighs when it rules against an LLM fallback stage -- and it is evidence AGAINST that fallback, because the candidate design (verbatim anchor quote relocated to offsets, emitted as `extracted`) would locate this text and then report the wrong STATUS at high confidence, converting an honest `missing` into a confident misclassification. The deterministic fix is a heading-shape change costing $0, in the same family as ADR-017's IBR phrasing fix. HELD-OUT BURN: authoring this case is exactly what evals/heldout/README.md's burn rule names as influence, so axp-2008-heldout is burned as of 2026-08-19 (T12) and no longer counts in any held-out denominator -- see ADR-020 and the heldout run history.

provenance: T12 (2026-08-19), ADR-020. Found while enumerating the fallback-addressable surface for the T12 ruling, by reading the committed held-out report evals/report/20260817-224952-fast.json (axp-2008-heldout: items 10, 11, 12, 13 all status=missing, confidence=0.40) against the document itself. The combined heading was verified in the RAW BYTES, not via the normalizer: re.finditer(r'ITEMS\b', raw) over evals/heldout/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm returns exactly ONE hit, at offset 1225493, and it is the bold combined heading quoted above. The strings 'Item 10', 'Item 11', 'Item 12' and 'Item 13' in their SINGULAR form occur zero times, which is what evals/heldout/axp-2008-heldout.json's provenance checked; that provenance's conclusion -- 'American Express addressed Part III without writing the item headings at all, and jumped straight from Item 9B to Item 14' -- overreached from the singular-form scan and is corrected here. This is the sixth time in this project that the verification instrument rather than the pipeline was at fault (evals/heldout/README.md's authoring-discipline section counts the first five). The held-out case evals/heldout/axp-2008-heldout.json still asserts `missing` for these four items and still passes; that assertion is now known to encode a label the document does not support, and correcting it is T14 work (taxonomy completeness), not T12's. The four item_present checks here are the whole of the debt and are expected to stay red until a post-freeze ADR admits combined-heading fan-out; the three hygiene checks are bookkeeping, exactly as in cvx-2015-internal-pointer.json. If the four ever go green the runner says 'NOW GREEN -- promote it'.
